'''Ząbkovia Ząbki''' ({{IPA|pl|zɔmpˈkɔvja ˈzɔmpkʲi}}) is a Polish professional [[association football|football]] club, based in [[Ząbki]], [[Masovian Voivodeship]]. The club's colors are red, white, and blue.<ref name="Historia_Dolcanu">{{cite web |url= http://www.dolcanzabki.com/klub/historia |title= Historia |website= Dolcan Ząbki - oficjalny serwis klubu |language= pl |access-date= 2018-05-30 |archive-date= 2018-05-30 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20180530145952/http://www.dolcanzabki.com/klub/historia |url-status= dead }}</ref> Its biggest successes were achieved when the club was called '''Dolcan Ząbki''' {{IPA|pl|ˈdɔlkan|}}, between 1994 and 2018.

They currently compete in the [[III liga|fourth tier]], after winning the [[IV liga]] promotion play-offs in 2025."}}
